text-on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an accent fill

text-accent.$description: Brand-coloured words that are not links: an emphasised phrase in body or small text (IP22). 4.5:1 on the page and raised surfaces; never the only carrier of meaning

text-accent-display.$description: Brand-coloured words in large text only, a heading at size 2 or larger or a statement (IP22): 3:1 on the page and raised surfaces (WCAG large text)

bg-tint.$description: A neutral fill one clear step from the page in both themes (lighter in dark, darker in light): a person's chat bubble (F15.65). Text on it holds 4.5:1

border-group.$description: The outline of a group its fill already marks (a segmented control): the fill’s own tone, so it draws nothing until more contrast raises it

border.$description: Outlines that separate where space and tone cannot: soft in standard contrast, where fills do most of the separating (Q71)

border-strong.$description: Outlines that are the control’s only mark: unchecked boxes and radios, switch tracks, slider rails (3:1 non-text)

border-control.$description: Outlines of boxed controls their fill already marks (fields, selects, default buttons, chips): soft in standard contrast, text strength in more contrast (Q71)

bg-control.$description: The fill of boxed controls (fields, selects, default buttons, chips): a subtle step from every surface (page, raised, sunken), so the fill, not the outline, tells a control from its surface. More contrast: the raised surface with a strong outline (Q71)

accent.$description: Primary actions, selected and checked fills

status.$description: Functional colours: one meaning each, never decoration. fg for text and icons on any surface, bg for a tint behind a message, border at 3:1 on the canvas, fill for solid emphasis and on-fill for text on it.

bg.$description: Information: background tint behind a message

on-fill.$description: Information: text and icons on the solid fill

fg.$description: Success (also good, positive, done): text and icons

bg.$description: Success (also good, positive, done): background tint behind a message

border.$description: Success (also good, positive, done): outline, 3:1 on the canvas

fill.$description: Success (also good, positive, done): solid emphasis fill

on-fill.$description: Success (also good, positive, done): text and icons on the solid fill

fg.$description: Warning (also alert, caution): text and icons

bg.$description: Warning (also alert, caution): background tint behind a message

border.$description: Warning (also alert, caution): outline, 3:1 on the canvas

fill.$description: Warning (also alert, caution): solid emphasis fill

on-fill.$description: Warning (also alert, caution): text and icons on the solid fill

fg.$description: Danger (also bad, negative, error, destructive): text and icons

bg.$description: Danger (also bad, negative, error, destructive): background tint behind a message

border.$description: Danger (also bad, negative, error, destructive): outline, 3:1 on the canvas

fill.$description: Danger (also bad, negative, error, destructive): solid emphasis fill

on-fill.$description: Danger (also bad, negative, error, destructive): text and icons on the solid fill

fg.$description: Neutral status (no judgement: draft, inactive): text and icons; follows muted text, so more contrast raises it

bg.$description: Neutral status: background tint behind a message

border.$description: Neutral status: outline, 3:1 on the canvas

on-fill.$description: Neutral status: text and icons on the solid fill

text-muted.$description: Private. Standard-contrast secondary text, read by color.text-muted and the standard-contrast context

border.$description: Private. Standard-contrast outline, read by color.border and the standard-contrast context

border-strong.$description: Private. Standard-contrast control outline, read by color.border-strong and the standard-contrast context

border-control.$description: Private. Standard-contrast outline of a filled control, read by color.border-control and the standard-contrast context

bg-control.$description: Private. Standard-contrast control fill, read by color.bg-control and the standard-contrast context
